description: Frame a finite one-dimensional float64 signal into complete windows using positive integer window and hop sizes in samples. Return a read-only float64 view; trailing incomplete windows are dropped. Values and units are preserved, and the view aliases the caller-owned signal.
validity_bound: Finite nonempty one-dimensional NumPy float64 array; positive integer window and hop sizes, with at least one complete window. Read-only output aliases the input: later input mutations remain visible. No padding, resampling, time inference or domain-specific interpretation.

ports.name: signal
ports.constraints: Finite one-dimensional float64 array covering at least one window; caller owns sample units and ordering.

ports.name: window_size
ports.constraints: Positive integer window length in samples, no larger than signal length.

ports.name: hop_size
ports.constraints: Positive integer step in samples; overlap or gaps are explicit.

ports.name: windows
ports.constraints: Read-only float64 view with shape ((len(signal)-window_size)//hop_size+1,window_size), preserving input units and aliasing input storage.

limitations: Constructed signal examples establish framing behavior, not empirical application performance.
Qualification is for float64 inputs, as required by the ensemble boundary. Other dtypes are not added to the contract.
Read-only does not mean immutable: caller mutation of the input changes the aliased output.
No source provider edits, catalog mutation or approval in this validator.
